verdict.rationale: Perplexity has a dedicated docs page stating that structured output makes the model return JSON conforming to a schema you define, so you can deserialize it directly. Sonar requests are being reformulated as Agent API requests, so this Agent API capability applies to the Sonar product. Missing for 10: detail on which schema features are supported and how strictly they are enforced, examples showing it combined with web-grounded answers, and independent or hands-on confirmation that outputs reliably match the schema.
